senses.gloss: ch. <cite ref="S00531">same</cite>. Targ. O. a. Y. I <cite ref="Numbers 13:23">Num. XIII, 23</cite> (Y. II <he>קטעו</he>). Targ. O. ib. 24 (Y. <he>קציצו</he>); a. fr.—Part. <cite ref="S01116"><he>קָיִץ</he></cite>, <cite ref="S00945"><he>קָיִיץ</he></cite>.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 10:3">Targ. Jer. X, 3</cite>.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 107b:15">B. Mets. 107ᵇ</cite> <he>נֵיקוּץ מר</he> cut the forest, sir (to allow a tow-path along the river).
Ib. קָיִיצְנָא, v. infra; a. e. [Ib. קוצו עילאי וכ׳, v. infra].—Trnsf. (cmp. פָּסַק) to determine, agree, appropriate.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 5:15">Targ. Y. Num. V, 15</cite> <he>דקָיִץ עלה וכ׳</he> (not <he>דקַיִץ</he>) for which he makes an appropriation in her behalf out of her property.—

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 67a:9">B. Mets. 67ᵃ</cite> <he>לא קָץ ליה</he> he did not explicitly allow him the usufruct of the mortgaged property (<cite ref="M02910"><he>מַשְׁכַּנְתָּא</he></cite>), v. <cite ref="S01132"><he>קִיצוּתָא</he></cite>.—Part. pass. <cite ref="S01115"><he>קִיץ</he></cite> q. v.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="S00531">same</cite>. [Targ. Y. Num. l. c., v. supra.]—
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 107b">B. Mets. 107ᵇ</cite> <he>נִיקַיְּיצוּ עילאי</he> … <he>והדר ניקוץ אנא</he> Rashi (ed. <he>קוצו</he>, incorr.; Ms. M. <he>ניקצו … וקציינא</he>, fr. <cite ref="S01806"><he>קְצֵי</he></cite>) let the owners of the upper and those of the lower parts of the forest cut (a path), and then I shall do likewise.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 107b:16">Ib.</cite> <he>אי קיְּיצוּ קָיִיצְנָא וכ׳</he> had they cut (their part), I should cut, but as they have not, why should I? <cite ref="Bava Metzia 108a:3">Ib. 108ᵃ</cite> <he>מאן קַיְּיצֵיה להאי לִיקּוֹץ ענפיה</he> Ms. H. (ed. <he>מַאן קַצְיֵיה תִּקּוֹץ וכ׳</he>) who ordered the cutting of this (my forest)? may his branch (offspring) be cut off; a. e.

senses.gloss: (fr. קְצַץ) to be cut off, v. supra.—V. קְצַץ, קְצִי.
